## Where is the Vocabulary?

The human readable version can be accessed from 

<https://w3id.org/iucn-get/IUCNEcosystemTypology>

And navigate through the hierarchy:

- <https://w3id.org/iucn-get/Realm_FM>
- <https://w3id.org/iucn-get/Biome_FM1>
- <https://w3id.org/iucn-get/EFG_FM1_2>

The identifiers resolve to the current (demo) version hosted at <https://demo.vocabs.ardc.edu.au/>

## Using R package `rdflib`

Load the libraries for this example

```{r}
library(rdflib)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
```

## Read vocabulary

You can download a copy or access the file online. There are multiple formats and points of access.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Read online file

```{r}
online_file <- paste(
    c("https://demo.vocabs.ardc.edu.au",
    "registry/api/resource/downloads/7901",
    "IUCN-GET-profiles-exported-2026-04-01_skos-2.ttl"),
    collapse = "/")

IUCNGET <- rdf_parse(online_file)
```

### SPARQL 1.1 Query endpoints

```{r}
sparql_endpoint <- "https://demo.vocabs.ardc.edu.au/repository/api/sparql/ands-nc_iucn-get-example_2026-04-01-v3"
```

:::

## Test RDF query

```{r}

query <- "
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>

SELECT ?scheme ?title WHERE {
  ?scheme a skos:ConceptScheme ;
          skos:prefLabel ?title .
}
"

rdf_query(IUCNGET,query)
```


## Complex queries

```{r}

query = "
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX iucn: <https://w3id.org/iucn-get/ontology#>

SELECT ?efg ?efg_id ?efg_name ?efg_drivers ?efg_properties ?efg_distribution
       ?biome_id ?biome_name 
       ?realm_id ?realm_name 
WHERE {
  # 1. Get the EFGs
  ?efg a iucn:EcosystemFunctionalGroup ;
             skos:prefLabel ?efg_name ;
             skos:notation ?efg_id ;
             iucn:ecosystemProperties ?efg_properties;
             iucn:ecologicalDrivers ?efg_drivers;
             iucn:distribution ?efg_distribution;
             skos:broader ?biome .
  
  # 2. Get the biomes
  ?biome skos:prefLabel ?biome_name ;
         skos:notation ?biome_id ;
         skos:broader ?realm .
  
  # 3. Get the realms
  ?realm skos:prefLabel ?realm_name ;
         skos:notation ?realm_id .
  
  # Language filters
  FILTER(LANG(?efg_name) = 'en' && LANG(?efg_properties) = 'en' && LANG(?efg_distribution) = 'en' && LANG(?efg_drivers) = 'en' && LANG(?biome_name) = 'en' && LANG(?realm_name) = 'en')
}
"
```

## Table with profiles
```{r}

IUCNGET_profiles <- rdf_query(IUCNGET,query)

IUCNGET_profiles
```

## Data wrangling in R

```{r}
IUCNGET_profiles |> 
  filter(biome_id %in% c("T1")) |>
  select(efg_id, efg_name)
```

---


```{r}
#| output: asis
IUCNGET_profiles |> 
  filter(efg_id %in% c("T1.2")) |>
  transmute(
    profile_text = sprintf("**Key ecological drivers for %s**: %s",
    efg_id, efg_drivers)) |>
    pull() |> cat()
```
